What to Expect

The Bodyshop Technical Trainer position requires someone with exceptional ability to deliver learning solutions within their region. The Tesla Bodyshop Technical Trainer will take responsibility for ensuring our internal and external repair network is equipped to deliver the best ownership experience the world has ever seen for every Tesla owner. Key responsibilities include facilitating hands-on technical Onboarding and Continuous Bodyshop technical training, mentoring and supporting Bodyshop technicians, and partnering closely with local Bodyshop Managers and regional network managers to train for skill gaps and elevate the performance of their teams and regions.   This individual must be creative, proactive, organized, flexible, results-oriented, and have a passion for and understanding of electric vehicles. Must have outstanding communication, facilitation, and organizational skills while demonstrating a positive and professional demeanor.Please note that only 1 role/headscount is open, to be hired either in the UK or Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Facilitate Onboarding and Continuous instructor-led and virtual Bodyshop technical training on electric vehicles equipped with complex automotive and electromechanical systems to enable employees to perform their role safely and to Tesla’s standards
- Maintain expert knowledge of the most current product knowledge, systems, methods, techniques, and best practices of Bodyshop repair procedure and processes  
- Support the Content Development team with reviewing training material, as needed  
- Support local apprentice programs as needed, including delivering training, supporting apprentice mentors, and reviewing training materials
- Partner with Managers and Coaches to identify and train for skill gap development of employees
- Serve, coach and mentor a network of Internal Bodyshop technicians and coaches to enhance core capabilities and ensure continuous process improvement
- Support and manage any local and specific projects with minimal guidance

What You’ll Bring

- Fluency in English is a non-negotiable requirement. Dutch and German language skills would be a plus
- Strong understanding of vehicle body repair processes, including aluminum and steel welding, mechanical, electrical, trim and refinishing knowledge. Experience of electric vehicles repairs is strongly preferred
- Strong facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills required
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrated confidence and professionalism in working in a customer-facing role
- Proactive, flexible, confident, professional, and self-directed in a fast-paced environment
- Ability to travel at least 60% of the time, with a valid Driver’s License and a valid passport
- Experience with environmental and safety requirements is a plus

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

SCHOTT Pharma designs solutions grounded in science to ensure that medications are safe and easy to use for people around the world - because human health matters. The portfolio comprises drug containment and delivery solutions for injectable drugs ranging from prefillable glass and polymer syringes, to cartridges, vials, and ampoules. Every day, a team of around 4,700 people from over 65 nations works at SCHOTT Pharma to contribute to global healthcare. The company is represented in all main pharmaceutical hubs with 17 manufacturing sites in Europe, North and South America, and Asia. With over 900 patents and technologies developed in-house, a state-of-the-art R&D center in Switzerland, and around 130 employees in R&D, the company is focused on developing innovations for the future. SCHOTT Pharma AG & Co. KGaA, headquartered in Mainz, Germany, is part of SCHOTT AG that is owned by the Carl Zeiss Foundation. In light of this spirit, SCHOTT Pharma is committed to sustainable development for society and the environment and has the strategic goal of becoming climate-neutral by 2030. Currently, SCHOTT Pharma has over 1,700 customers including the top 30 leading pharma manufacturers for injectable drugs and generated sales of EUR 650 million in the fiscal year 2021.
About us

Human health matters.
That is why SCHOTT Pharma designs science-based solutions to help ensure medicines are safe and easy to use for people around the world.

As part of our digital transformation, SCHOTT Pharma is advancing its journey towards becoming a data-driven and AI-enabled organization. To support this vision, we are building a growing Data & AI Delivery Team and establishing a modern, scalable data and AI platform that connects business-critical data across functions and enables innovative AI solutions at enterprise scale.

To strengthen this newly evolving team, we are looking for an experienced AI Engineer / Architect who combines strong technical expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. In this role, you will help design, deliver, and operationalize AI solutions that create tangible business value across the organization.

Your responsibilities

- Design and implement scalable AI and data solutions that support strategic business objectives and operational excellence across SCHOTT Pharma
- Drive the architecture, delivery, and operationalization of custom-built AI use cases from ideation to productive deployment
- Translate complex business challenges into pragmatic, cost-efficient, and scalable AI solutions
- Provide technical leadership for AI initiatives and contribute to shaping SCHOTT Pharma's long-term AI roadmap and architecture landscape
- Guide and challenge external implementation partners and consultants to ensure high-quality delivery and sustainable solutions
- Contribute to the development of a modern enterprise data and AI platform, establishing standards, best practices, and governance approaches
- Support the integration of AI capabilities into existing business processes while ensuring maintainability, scalability, and operational readiness
- Monitor, optimize, and continuously improve deployed AI solutions to maximize business impact
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Data & Analytics to identify opportunities for innovation
- Act as a trusted advisor and translator between technical teams and business stakeholders, making AI concepts accessible and actionable

Your profile

- Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in AI, Data, Machine Learning, Solution Architecture, or related disciplines
- Proven experience delivering AI solutions from concept through implementation and operation
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI Services, Azure AI Foundry, or comparable hyperscaler environments
- Strong programming skills, preferably in Python
- Experience working with data platforms, cloud architectures, and AI solution ecosystems
- Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, or related AI technologies
- Familiarity with Data Engineering, MLOps, or AI Operations concepts is advantageous
- Experience coordinating external vendors, implementation partners, or consulting teams
Experience in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environments is considered a strong advantage
- Ability to translate complex technical topics into business-oriented recommendations
- Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving skills, and a pragmatic hands-on mindset
- Comfortable taking ownership and providing technical guidance in cross-functional environments
- Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken; good command of german is desirable

Your Benefits

SCHOTT's openness to promote your further development is just as great as our additional benefits. Ranging from active health management via flexible working hours and hybrid work all the way to corporate pension plans: everything geared to suit your goals and needs. Discover a special corporate culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop their entire potential.
At SCHOTT, you can expect a unique corporate culture where we emphasize equity, diversity, and inclusion. We know: motivated and committed employees are the precondition for the success of our company.

Your contact person

You can expect interesting tasks and challenging projects, as well as motivated and friendly teams in fields that influence our future. Do you want to be successful with us? Then, please send us your application: SCHOTT Pharma AG & Co. KGaA, Human Resources, Adrian Fuchs
*At SCHOTT, it's your personality that counts - not your gender, your identity, or origin.

What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Manager (f/md) for Supplier Relationship Management & Supply Chain Resilience, you will work closely with the management team of GS D Procurement and the Gas Services Project Orion. Your role is essential to drive objectives of the ORION project to de-risk the GS D supply chain. In this role you report to the Head of Commodity Management and will work closely with the head of GS D procurement and the CPOs of the product lines, as well as the project organization in Gas Services. The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities
* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams
* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI
* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS D

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, combined with project management skills, and understanding of supply chain topics across the value chain from Sales, to Engineering and to Procurement. 
* Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.
* Fluent in English and German is an advantage 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before last application date.
For questions about the role, please contact the recruiting manager Lina Himmelreich on lina.himmelreich.ext@siemens-energy.com or tel. +491727619376
For questions about the recruitment process please contact the recruiter responsible.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

We are looking for a proactive and analytical Business Controller to join our CP Business Controlling team. In this role, you will support financial steering and decision-making through high-quality financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and budgeting activities. You will work closely with business stakeholders and finance teams to provide transparency on business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and support the achievement of financial targets.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Perform financial analyses, KPI monitoring, variance analysis, and financial simulations to support business decision-making
* Prepare and coordinate monthly MOR reporting and management presentations in close collaboration with key stakeholders
* Support and coordinate monthly forecasting, annual budgeting, and long-term planning processes, ensuring timely and accurate deliverables
* Consolidate business stakeholder inputs, ensure forecast consistency and accuracy, and monitor deviations with actionable recommendations
* Drive continuous improvement of planning assumptions, forecasting methodologies, financial transparency, and overall controlling effectiveness
* Support and promote digitalization and automation initiatives across controlling, reporting, and planning processes

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
* Experience in Business Controlling, FP&A, Financial Reporting, or a similar finance function
* Understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial planning processes
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP, Power BI, or other reporting and planning tools is an advantage

We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x) Biology (Life Sciences) for Preclinical Imaging

Radiochemie TV-L: 38,5 h/week (100%) 1-year fixed-term contract under the WissZeitVG; plus a 1-year extension for a third-party funded project
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks
• Planning, conducting and analyzing the biological evaluation of newly developed PET and SPECT radiotracers
• Contributing to the establishment, optimization and
documentation of biological test systems and preclinical evaluation protocols
• Performing in vitro studies, including stability, binding and cellular uptake assays as well as studies using models of the blood-brain-barrier
• Preclinical evaluation of tracer candidates in suitable in vivo models, including support of small-animal imaging studies
• Performing and analyzing ex vivo studies, e.g., autoradiography, biodistribution studies and complementary tissue analyses
• Quantitative analysis of biological and imaging data and
interpretation of results in close interaction with the other project partners
• Evaluation, documentation, and scientific presentation of experimental results in project reports, publications, and presentations

Your profile
• Completed university degree and Ph.D. in biology, life sciences, neuroscience, biochemistry, pharmacy or a related field
• Experience in preclinical imaging (e.g. small animal PET, SPECT, MRI, CT)
• Experience with animal models and experimental animal work is advantageous (FELASA-B or EU functions A, C, D)
• Experience with cell culture, in vitro assays, autoradiography, ex vivo analyses and BBB models is desirable
• Interest in radiopharmaceutical tracer development, molecular imaging and translational research
• Willingness to work with unsealed radioactive substances and to become familiar with radiation protection-related workflows
• Willingness to conduct biological and preclinical experiments within an interdisciplinary team
• Good written and spoken English skills
• Structured, independent and conscientious working style
• Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills and interest in interdisciplinary collaboration between chemistry, radiochemistry, biology, medicine and imaging

Our offer

Your future in detail
The Institute of Radiochemistry and Experimental Molecular Imaging (IREMB) is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a translational research project in the field of radiopharmaceutical tracer development and molecular imaging. The postdoc position will initially be embedded for one year in the internationally funded IMAGESTRO project. There is an option of extension for another year. The focus of the work will be on the biological validation of newly developed PET or SPECT radiotracers.
The IMAGESTRO project aims to develop novel 18F-labeled PET tracers for the non-invasive imaging of estrogen receptors in the brain, to characterize them preclinically, and to translate them into human applications. The project focuses on the organic synthesis of suitable precursor and reference compounds, the development and optimization
of radiofluorination strategies, and the comprehensive analytical and preclinical characterization of the resulting radiotracers.
